en: The shutter is shut tight. A switch somewhere must work it.
Not so fast. What I told you before was a lie. I thought if I stuck to you, you'd lead me to that Lance.
He never turned up. Never mind. I meant to beat you after him, but you'll do first. I always settle my debts!
...I don't get it. Was that Lance right? That I don't treat my Pokémon properly? Love... trust... Is that what I'm missing?
Is that why I keep losing? I don't understand. But I'm not finished. Not now, not like this. I'll never give up!
